name: wno_transfer_film
description: Wavelet Neural Operator with the FiLM-transfer recipe: the benchmark-winning FNO+FiLM-transfer model with the ONLY change being the backbone -- the Fourier spectral conv is swapped for a native, differentiable single-level 2-D discrete wavelet convolution (WaveletConv2d, db4 with Haar fallback). Analysis=periodic correlation-downsample, synthesis=upsample-convolution with the same orthonormal filters (perfect reconstruction, verified <1e-4 via a mandatory DWT->IDWT assert). 1-D-safe (H==1 -> transform along W only), odd-size safe (circular pad to even, crop back). Each subband (LL,LH,HL,HH; L,H in 1-D) carries its own per-coefficient-position weight (in_ch,out_ch,m1,m2) applied up to a mode cap via einsum bixy,ioxy->boxy, with higher positions passed through. FiLM conditioning on X and the LF-pretrain -> HF-finetune transfer schedule are byte-for-byte the winner, so this is a clean Fourier-vs-wavelet backbone comparison holding conditioning + schedule fixed. Single-level WNO (official tripura2023wno is multi-level on the coarsest band).
